name: rosetta-perceptron
code:
use default
use Raster.IMAGE

struct V3(x: double, y: double, bias: double) is
    +(o: V3) -> V3 => V3(x + o.x, y + o.y, bias + o.bias)
    *(k: double) -> V3 => V3(x * k, y * k, bias * k)
    ⋅(o: V3) -> double => x * o.x + y * o.y + bias * o.bias
si

let slope = 0.7D
let intercept = 0.1D
let rate = 0.01D

above(x: double, y: double) -> int =>
    if y > slope * x + intercept then 1 else -1 fi

let random = System.Random(10)

let spread = () => random.next_double() * 2.0D - 1.0D

let points =
    (0..2000)
        |> map(_ => V3(spread(), spread(), 1.0D))
        |> collect_list()

let weights mut = V3(spread(), spread(), spread())

guess(p: V3) -> int => if weights ⋅ p >= 0.0D then 1 else -1 fi

train(p: V3) is
    let error = above(p.x, p.y) - guess(p)

    weights = weights + p * (rate * cast double(error))
si

correct() -> int =>
    points |> filter(p => guess(p) == above(p.x, p.y)) |> count()

write_line("the line to learn is y = {slope}x + {intercept}")
write_line()
write_line("after   0 passes: {correct(),4} of {points.count} correct")

for pass in 1::100 do
    for p in points do
        train(p)
    od

    if pass <= 3 \/ pass % 25 == 0 then
        write_line(
            "after {pass,3} passes: "
            "{correct(),4} of {points.count} correct")
    fi
od

let learned_slope = -weights.x / weights.y
let learned_intercept = -weights.bias / weights.y

write_line()
write_line(
    "the perceptron's line is y = "
    "{learned_slope:F3}x + {learned_intercept:F2}")

write_line("in the picture, blue points are guessed above the line,")
write_line("green below and red wrongly; the line learned is orange")

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

image.view(-1.0D, -1.0D, 1.0D, 1.0D)
image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 250ub)

for p in points do
    if guess(p) != above(p.x, p.y) then
        image.colour(220ub, 30ub, 30ub)
        image.dot(p.x, p.y, 3.0D)
    elif guess(p) == 1 then
        image.colour(60ub, 110ub, 200ub)
        image.dot(p.x, p.y, 2.0D)
    else
        image.colour(90ub, 170ub, 90ub)
        image.dot(p.x, p.y, 2.0D)
    fi
od

image.stroke(1.5D)
image.colour(30ub, 30ub, 30ub)
image.line(
    -1.0D, intercept - slope,
    1.0D, intercept + slope)

image.colour(230ub, 140ub, 20ub)
image.line(
    -1.0D, learned_intercept - learned_slope,
    1.0D, learned_intercept + learned_slope)

image.write("perceptron.png")

image.show("perceptron.png")
